notes.title: Play the demo for the upcoming sequel!
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that you can now try the demo for [i][b]The Hidden Art of Innkeeping[/b][/i] on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2613800/The_Hidden_Art_of_Innkeeping/]Steam[/url]! You may be able to spot a couple familiar faces from [i][b]The Lost Art of Innkeeping[/b][/i]. :)

If you have any feedback on the demo, I'd love to hear it, and you can post it in this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2613800/discussions/0/4139438760461008577/]discussion topic on Steam[/url]. You can post any bugs you find there as well (I really hope there won't be any!).

[b]Steam Next Fest [/b] is coming up next month (Feb 5-12), and I'm sure you're going to see lots of exciting new games in that! I'm participating as well and planning to do a couple livestreams of the demo. I'll also try to do a practice run before that, to test things out. Here's the tentative schedule if you want to check them out (you'll be able to see them on [i][b]The Hidden Art of Innkeeping[/b][/i]'s Steam page):

[list][*]Practice run: 12:00 pm (noon) PT on Sat, Feb 3 (20:00 UTC on Sat, Feb 3)
[*]Steam Next Fest Livestream 1: 7:00 pm PT on Tue, Feb 6 (03:00 UTC on Wed, Feb 7)
[*]Steam Next Fest Livestream 2: 12:00 pm (noon) PT on Sat, Feb 10 (20:00 UTC on Sat, Feb 10)[/list]
I'm very nervous because I've not livestreamed before. I would say it'll be more of a casual get-together where I'll play the demo and answer any questions, rather than a slick, professional production (it's totally not going to be anything near that). Anyway, I'd love to chat with players/gamedevs if you can make it!

notes.title: Version 1.2: New upgrades available!
notes.content:
Have you always wanted a gondola for your manor, or well-sculpted bushes in your garden? Or even a dramatic sculpture to decorate your lawn? Well, even if you never thought you’d want them, now you can have them! These upgrades are available in late game, when certain conditions are fulfilled, and some very important guests will appreciate your gorgeously upgraded garden!

You can get these upgrades either in a new game or a previously-saved game, even if you’ve already finished the game, as long as the conditions are fulfilled and you go to sleep at least once after loading the game.

In addition, when finding a particular item in Frank’s house, you can now choose to take it or not, and this has an effect on a subsequent event. 

I also fixed a couple of bugs (one that can occur when sleeping in one of the guest rooms after getting an item from the tailor, and another that occurred if the player did not make preparations for the celebratory days) and a minor issue with one of the NPC’s movements in the garden.

Thanks once again to various players for their suggestions and feedback!

Summary of changes in version 1.2:
[list]
[*] Added new upgrades for the garden.
[*] Added the choice to take an item or not after finding it in Frank’s house.
[*] Fixed a rare bug that could occur upon waking up.
[*] Fixed a bug that could occur if preparations weren’t made for celebratory days.
[*] Fixed a minor issue with one of the NPC’s movements. 
[/list]
